description: PROGRAM ALLOCATION AUCTION, held until a price is named; no bid is taken today: a holder signs a bid record for ONE slot of a lot the house published, a small, stated number of slots of optional premium program capacity that exists now. A bid is only a record you sign with your own wallet: it holds no NET, moves no NET and escrows nothing, and you can withdraw it until the lot closes. Claiming a job, voting, proof, evidence reads and finding work stay free and are never part of a lot. You name the lot's id and its hash (net_auction_status gives both), a whole number of NET units for one slot, and your own bid's id (you choose it; the same id and the same terms read the bid back). One wallet holds one bid on a lot. commit places the bid; withdraw ends your own bid until the lot closes, even while the NET programs are stopped. FREE to sign, no fee, no gas, and nothing is charged by these tools. The house sets one price per slot, read from its own setting and BLANK by default: while it is blank no bid is taken and this step refuses before you sign. A winner would be told to pay only through the order system, after delivery; no door for that payment is built yet. The program is built but held off until the operator switches it on, and it stays out of the joint switch-on: it has its own go, after a price is named. Until then a new bid is refused before you sign, and a withdrawal only works on a bid that exists. Two refusals depend on this wallet's own records and are answered only when you submit, so prepare never says which wallet holds what: the wallet may already hold a bid on this lot, or the bid id may already be in use with other terms. A withdrawal's prepare says the same for every bid id, because no keyless read shows a bid: the door refuses an id that is not a bid, or a bid on a lot that has closed, only when you submit, before the signature is spent. A withdrawal by a wallet that did not place the bid is refused only after the signature is verified, which spends the signature. This moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through these tools. Never put a phone number, an email or a street address in any field. Returns MESSAGE_TO_SIGN and BODY_JSON; sign with the holder wallet's personal_sign, then call submit_net_auction within 5 minutes. Cost and signer: free, no gas; the person signs the result with their own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

act.description: commit places a new bid, or withdraw ends one you hold.

bidUnits.description: commit: your bid for one slot, a whole number of NET units. It is your own number, never filled in for you, and a bid under the house price cannot win.

lotId.description: commit: the id of a published lot (net_auction_status lists them).

lotSha256.description: commit: the 64-character lowercase hash of the lot you read. A changed word changes the hash.

principal.description: The 0x… address that signs: the wallet that places the bid. Address only, never a private key.

reason.description: withdraw: optional, one plain sentence, up to 280 characters. Only you ever read it back.

recordId.description: The bid's id: 1 to 80 letters, numbers and . _ : -. You choose it when you commit; the same id and the same terms read the bid back.

name: prepare_net_auction
title: Place or withdraw your own bid record for one slot of a published lot (step 1 of 2)
